read_me_first.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
because: SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
SPY sits -2.67 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits -3.53 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.92 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Advertising Technology, Marine Shipping, Oil and Gas Upstream — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
caveats: DATA NOT CURRENT (expected session 2026-11-17): dispersion_vixeq as of 2026-11-16 [PUBLISHER_LAG]; dspx as of 2026-11-16 [PUBLISHER_LAG]. Readings that depend on them are older than today's close.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~730, breakout level ~755 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~775.

manage_note.doctrine: Trade management changes when the 8-day average of net new highs crosses back above the 20-day. -- The VIV System (quoted doctrine, not an Aegis rule)

doctrine.trim: Trim into strength -- take some profit while the stock is still going up, not after it rolls over. (piece 17)
doctrine.trail: Trail the rest -- one moving average, daily closes only. (piece 18)
doctrine.add: Adds and pyramids -- add to a winner only when it proves itself again, never to average down. (piece 19)

last_five.doctrine: Check your last five trades before you size the next one. -- The VIV System (quoted doctrine, not an Aegis rule)
